methods.name: Parametric count/signed/event laws

methods.name: Original fixed point ensemble

methods.name: Ridge without opponent/workload/team
methods.recipe: Same earlier-only learner with one predeclared feature group removed; no group selected retrospectively.

methods.name: 28-feature public NGS addition

methods.name: 47-feature PBP/schedule addition

methods.name: SITE-held three-appearance pooled YPA
methods.recipe: Original SITE attempt point * sum(H3 pass_yd)/sum(H3 pass_att); exactly3 qualified appearances; unchanged SITE-yard fallback.

methods.name: SITE-held pooled completion conversion
methods.recipe: Original SITE attempt point * sum(H3 completions)/sum(H3 attempts), original selected H3 and unchanged completion fallback.

methods.name: Frozen attempts workload GLM
methods.recipe: Log-link mean of training-standardized log1p(player H3 attempts), log1p(team G5 attempts), positive-attempt fraction and missing flags; lambda1; original parameters/artifact gaps retained.

methods.name: Historical pooled passing efficiency
methods.recipe: Hold saved tree attempts fixed; multiply by H3 or H8 pooled YPA with commonH8 eligibility/fallback. Both lose pooled yard control.

methods.name: Historical pooled rushing efficiency
methods.recipe: Hold saved tree carries fixed; multiply H3/H8 pooled YPC. H8 small gain versus pooled, with adverse bias/tails and intervals crossing0.

methods.name: Original five-season RB carry-share proposal
methods.recipe: mu=tau*(SC+kappa*p0)/(ST+kappa), original five-prior-season p0/tau0 and kappa{0,25,100}; original history/fallback/window retained.

methods.name: Frozen reception half-adjustment
methods.recipe: raw_rec+.5*(adjusted_rec-raw_rec); original registration and2026Weeks7-14, no restart/backfill.

methods.name: Projected targets times H3 pooled YPT
methods.recipe: Same-cutoff projected targets * sum(H3 rec_yd)/sum(H3 targets); exact-three history/source adapter and unchanged SITE fallback.

methods.name: Same-receipt combined-yard point

methods.name: Empirical-leaf marginal forecast law

methods.name: Absolute-error/binary histogram boosting

methods.name: Count objective and role-specific boosting

methods.name: P0/P1/P2/P3/P4

reports/all12-leaf-cdf-v1/method-config..count: Geometric on {0,1,...}, equivalently fixed NB(r=1); mu=max(.05,mean(y)); q=mu/(1+mu); P(Y=k)=(1-q)*q**k. Mean=mu. No moment-matched dispersion claim.
reports/all12-leaf-cdf-v1/method-config..fractional_ppr: BLOCKED pending exact pinned website scoring/components; no generic provider total or invented zero labels.
reports/all12-leaf-cdf-v1/method-config..role_groups: position; each trained role prior uses all earlier supported played labels for that role, including zeros. Unknown/unseen role uses trained global prior with explicit fallback.
reports/all12-leaf-cdf-v1/method-config..signed_integer: Discrete Laplace at integer lower training role median c; s=max(1,mean(abs(y-c))); q=s/(1+s); P(Y=k)=(1-q)/(1+q)*q**abs(k-c). This is fixed support smoothing, not a claim that its MAD equals s. Mean=c; variance=2q/(1-q)^2.
